title: The main navigation and your home feed
description: What the sidebar holds, where the search box is, and what every panel on your home page is telling you.
body:
Your home page is your own player profile. The sidebar down the left is the same on every screen in Scoryboard.

Find your way around

  1. Sign in. Scoryboard opens your home page.

  2. Read the sidebar. Home brings you back here. Leaderboards, Tournament, Teams, Friends, Chat, Payment, Schedule and Subscriptions each open one part of Scoryboard.

  3. Use the search box at the top of the sidebar to find anybody on Scoryboard.

  4. Read the strip at the top of your home page. It holds your banner, your photo, your rating and four counters: Followers, Following, Leaderboard and Views. Views counts how many people have opened your profile.

  5. Read your statistics below it. Ten tiles: Matches, Win, Loss, Draw, W/L ratio, Player of the match, Goals scored, Assists and a tile for each card colour.

  6. Scroll to Trending for recent activity from across Scoryboard: teams created, matches finished, people following each other.

What you will see

Everything on your home page comes from what you have done. A new account shows zeroes in every tile and "No rankings yet" under Team rank. The numbers fill in as you play.

Trending is not your feed. It is activity from across Scoryboard, so most of it is about people and teams you have never met.

If it does not work

  • Your statistics are all zero after a match. They are written a short time after the match finishes, not the instant it ends. Reload the page in a minute.
  • A banner about a competition sits across the top. That is a Scoryboard promotion. Select the cross on the right to close it.
  • The sidebar is not there. Some screens, such as the sign-up steps, are drawn without it. Select the Scoryboard logo to get back.
